previous_assumption: Assumed listRequirements (GET /organizations/:id/requirements) branches server-side by org type the same way listQuotations and listRentals do, so it's safe to call for both a Renter and a Rental Company.
correction: listRequirements is rfq.manage-only (Renter's own posted requirements) — it throws ForbiddenError for a Rental Company. The Rental Company's equivalent is a genuinely different, unscoped call: apiClient.discoverRequirements (marketplace-wide open requirements, gated rfq.respond), used by requirements/page.tsx's separate RentalCompanyView component. Before reusing any list* endpoint across both org types on a new page (e.g. a dashboard), check whether the service method actually branches internally (listQuotations/listRentals do; listRequirements does not) rather than assuming symmetry from the nav item's dual-permission display.
